entries.name: Joyce Tillerson

expected.convicted: Yes — convicted by the Paris Assize Court, November 24, 1978; France tried the case rather than extradite
expected.sentence: Five years, two years suspended — imposed by the Paris Assize Court on November 24, 1978, for the July 31, 1972 hijacking of Delta Air Lines Flight 841. Having spent approximately two and a half years at Fleury-Mérogis Prison since her May 26, 1976 arrest in Paris, she was released within days of the verdict, having already served nearly the entire custodial portion. The French proceedings reportedly did not establish that she or Jean McNair had personally carried a weapon.

updates.sentence: Five years, two years suspended — imposed by the Paris Assize Court on November 24, 1978, for the July 31, 1972 hijacking of Delta Air Lines Flight 841. Having spent approximately two and a half years at Fleury-Mérogis Prison since her May 26, 1976 arrest in Paris, she remained imprisoned as of December 8, 1978, when the United States embassy reported that parole consideration had been postponed. Her actual release date remains unresolved. The French proceedings reportedly did not establish that she or Jean McNair had personally carried a weapon.

entries.rationale: November 24, 1978 is conviction date, not release. December 8 embassy cable explicitly confirms parole consideration still pending and describes documents she will receive when released. Clear disproved endpoint and calculated total; preserve released status. Actual endpoint unresolved. May 5, 1979 is merely projected sentence expiry and must not be inserted.

entries.name: Mahan Vanover

expected.sentence:
Six months in jail (1977) for contempt of a picket-limit order.

Verdict as recorded: Convicted of contempt during the Stearns, Kentucky coal strike and sentenced to six months.

Charges as recorded: Criminal contempt for violating a court order limiting pickets during the United Mine Workers (UMWA) recognition strike against the Blue Diamond Coal Company's Justus mine in Stearns, Kentucky (1976–79).

entries.rationale: Original reports establish October1977 contempt imprisonment; retain year-only release because medical leave and group December22 release cannot be equated. Later contemporary reporting gives actual56 days; not an inferred sentence duration.
